notes.summary: One handwritten subject-note page, numbered 66. Top definitions are followed by a cancelled attempt, a live brace with two marginal notes, double-prime definitions, reduction to constructions in M, and saturated-part definitions with a final pair. The top insertion enclosure, top continuation curve, left-note arrow, right-note enclosure, and M-zero insertion leader are reproduced in TikZ. Draft agreement was not treated as evidence.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No theorem or implication was proved. Formula structure directed attention to the first H_i relation, the final F-bar, p-counts, the passage punctuation, and the second support/cosupport noun. Each decision was made from local strokes. In particular the literal vdash, the colon in passage : une sous-figure, and son support are preserved despite more conventional-looking alternatives. The low point is kept without assigning a multiplication meaning. The small phi and two-upright form remain uncertain.
notes.author_checks: Cancelled text, independent renewed formula, old-letter remnants, raised additions, and possibly cancelled par retained. The first top equation and renewed cancelled equation are separate groups. No extra word is invented from the right-note connector or from the retraced family letter. The single word par carries alternative states. No outside-page evidence, OCR, text recognition, or LaTeX compilation was used.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Manuscript number 66 at top centre; scanpage 67 retained. No date, separate title sheet, or page-count statement. Partie saturée ... de is an underlined internal heading, with live raised family-zero and an overwritten M before final family F.
